Every 202 lands here. Poll with `logAfter` and use the returned `lastSeq` as the next cursor.

Reading needs **Read only** and changes need **Manage**, unless an endpoint says otherwise. [How to read this page](/docs/integrations/api-reference/#how-to-read-a-group-page).

### `GET /api/jobs`

Jobs, newest first; status, type, category and origin take comma lists.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Input:** `?q=&status=&type=&category=&origin=&siteSlug=&serverId=&scheduleId=&batchId=&since=&until=&limit=&offset=`
- **Returns:** `{items, total, counts (per status), retentionDays}`

### `GET /api/jobs/types`

Every job type with its name, description, category and time limit.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Returns:** `{items: [{type, label, description, category, internal, timeoutMs}]}`

### `GET /api/jobs/:id`

One job plus the log lines after a cursor.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Input:** `?logAfter=<seq>`
- **Returns:** `{job, logs[], lastSeq}`

### `POST /api/jobs/:id/cancel`

Cancel a queued job, or ask a running one to stop.

- **Level:** Manage
- **Notes:** Destructive
